# IDET Certified Cloud Operations & AWS Practitioner Masterclass (B2)

This repository tracks daily learning and hands-on practice completed during the AWS Cloud Operations & Practitioner masterclass.

## Project Summary

- Focus: AWS fundamentals to intermediate cloud operations skills
- Format: day-by-day notes, labs, demos, and study references
- Outcome: practical understanding of core AWS services across compute, networking, storage, security, scaling, and databases

## Day-by-Day Coverage

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED-SUMMARY:START -->
| Day | Coverage Summary | Main Artifacts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Day 1 | Cloud computing foundations: service models (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS), deployment models, AWS global infrastructure, Free Tier safety, and pricing basics. | `Day 1/IDET DAY 1.pdf` |
| Day 2 | IAM fundamentals: shared responsibility model, users/groups/roles/policies, policy evaluation, least privilege, MFA, auditing, and access controls. | `Day 2/IDET DAY 2.pdf` |
| Day 3 | EC2 fundamentals and compute concepts: instance customization, storage options (EBS/EFS/instance store), networking, firewalls, ELB, and ASG introduction. | `Day 3/DAY 3.pdf` |
| Day 4 | VPC networking deep dive plus a full EC2-hosted PHP + MySQL CRUD deployment (Student Management System) with Apache and security group setup. | `Day 4/Student Management System/README.md`, `Day 4/VPC Note/VPC.md`, `Day 4/Student Management System/create.php`, `Day 4/Student Management System/db.php` |
| Day 5 | High availability and scaling: vertical vs horizontal scaling, ALB target groups, health checks, and Auto Scaling Group setup/demo with cleanup steps. | `Day 5/DAY 5.md` |
| Day 6 | AWS storage architecture with S3 deep dive: storage class strategy, lifecycle policies, versioning, security controls, and static website hosting demo. | `Day 6/s3-storage.md`, `Day 6/index.html` |
| Day 7 | AWS database services: RDS/Aurora/DynamoDB concepts, guided RDS provisioning, DynamoDB CRUD + indexing + TTL demos, and database category study notes. | `Day 7/AWS_Database_Categories_Study_Notes.pdf`, `Day 7/databases.md` |
<!-- AUTO-GENERATED-SUMMARY:END -->

## What This Repository Helps You Learn

- Build a strong AWS foundation from day 1
- Connect theory to labs and deployable demos
- Revisit each day quickly using focused notes and files
- Prepare for AWS practitioner-level understanding with practical context
